description: Synthetic labelled test corpus. Messages were written by the project author based on patterns reported in the press; they contain no real person, phone number or IBAN. Splits: train (rules were tuned against it), holdout (30% set aside at the start; never looked at while building v0.1.0), hard (written after v0.1.0 was frozen with phrasings the rules did not know; v0.2.0 was tuned against it), blind1 (written after v0.2.0 was frozen; v0.3.0 was tuned against it), blind2 (written after v0.3.0 was frozen; v0.4.0 was tuned against it).
